title: Building and Development Dispute Resolution Committee decision 03-16: QDC MP 2.3 alternative solution for an existing residential care building; approval given with an added condition (Caboolture)
jurisdiction: Queensland, Australia. COMPARATIVE TEST ONLY: not Alberta; no Alberta applicability asserted.
code_edition: QDC MP 2.3 (Fire Safety in Existing Residential Care Buildings, pre 1 June 2007), publication date 14 June 2011 as cited (p. 4); BCA edition not stated (Table 7 cited, p. 2)
document_type: Sustainable Planning Act 2009 appeal decision (Building and Development Dispute Resolution Committee), Queensland
document_date: Committee decision dated 13 May 2016 (PDF p. 12); hearing 10 Mar 2016 (p. 1)

facts.text: QFES, as advice agency, appealed under Sustainable Planning Act 2009 s 528 the assessment manager's decision to grant a development permit for building work in an existing residential care building, approving an alternative solution under QDC MP 2.3.
The assessment manager's decision notice dated 28 Jan 2016 granted the development approval.
The Committee changed the assessment manager's decision and gave the approval subject to an additional condition on the alternative solution.

The condition requires the location of BCA-compliant additional gates and doors providing access between the covered walkways and the adjoining hostel blocks, and clearer identification in Table 1 (QDC requirements) and Table 7 (BCA requirements) of how acceptable solution A1 is not achieved.
QDC MP 2.3 is a mandatory part of the QDC applying to residential care buildings, and the notice says it came into effect for them on 1 Sept 2011.
The notice cites s 231AE of the Building Act 1975 and s 14 on when building work complies with the QDC.
